questions.prompt: The Marshall Plan provided aid to rebuild which region?
questions.fact: Congress approved about 13 billion dollars over four years, and the aid was deliberately offered to the Soviet bloc too, which refused it.

questions.prompt: What is the main component of natural gas?
questions.fact: It is odourless in its natural state; the rotten-egg smell is an additive put in deliberately so leaks can be detected.

questions.prompt: What is the term for three consecutive strikes in bowling?
questions.fact: The name is said to come from nineteenth-century tournaments that handed out an actual turkey as a prize.

questions.prompt: Which band's members included John, Paul, George, and Ringo?
questions.fact: Ringo joined last, replacing Pete Best weeks before the first single, and he is the only member never to sing lead on a number one.

questions.prompt: Which mountain range runs along the western edge of South America?
questions.fact: At roughly 7,000 kilometres it is the longest continental range on Earth, and it is still rising as two plates collide.

questions.prompt: Which epic poem describes the fall of Troy from a Roman perspective?
questions.fact: Virgil left it unfinished and asked for it to be burned; Augustus overruled him, which is the only reason it survives.

questions.prompt: Which port number is standard for HTTPS traffic?
questions.fact: Its unencrypted counterpart sits on port 80, and browsers now hide the prefix entirely because the secure version is assumed.
